summary: verifier-facts verdicts: C-0001 verified (correlate-existence, scope-limited); C-0002 verified; C-0003 verified; C-0004 verified-but-scoped (a theoretical-trend claim, not an established fact); C-0005 verified; C-0006 verified
content:
VERIFIER-FACTS VERDICTS:
- C-0001: VERIFIED. EV-0001/0002/0003/0004/0019 each directly state measurable changes during hypnosis. Sub-question 'do the cited papers report brain changes?' = YES for all. Scope-limit noted in claim: correlation ≠ causation. The contradicting EVs (0005/0006/0018/0020) attack 'uniqueness/specificity', not 'existence of any change' — so they don't falsify C-0001 as worded.
- C-0002: VERIFIED. EV-0005 ('no hypnosis-specific fingerprint'), EV-0006 (induction not time-locked), EV-0007 (response-set rejects unique state), EV-0008 (debate not resolved), EV-0009 (no robust neurophys evidence of special state; 54% not more suggestible), EV-0016 (Stroop Bayesian equivalence), EV-0020 (neurophys data don't resolve issue). The 54% figure traces to Braffman & Kirsch 1999 via Lynn/Kirsch/Terhune 2023 — secondary attribution but the source is named.
- C-0003: VERIFIED. EV-0013 quotes 'no consensus exists regarding the mechanisms' verbatim. EV-0018 quotes the ALE meta-analysis finding (medial lingual gyrus, not DMN/SN/CEN).
- C-0004: VERIFIED-BUT-SCOPED. The claim is about a theoretical TREND, and EV-0010/0011/0012/0014/0015 all confirm multiple 2022-2025 authors frame predictive coding as unifying. BUT the empirical decisiveness is not established — these are proposals with 'testable predictions'. Downgraded confidence from the reasoning worker's 'medium' is appropriate; the trend is real, the resolution is aspirational. EV-0017 (Dell/Lush) actually rejects BOTH state and nonstate, which slightly contradicts the 'synthesis dissolves dichotomy' framing — noted as a soft tension, not a hard conflict.
- C-0005: VERIFIED. EV-0008 quotes Oakley & Halligan ruling out the qualitative state hypothesis. EV-0016 (Stroop) supports.
- C-0006: VERIFIED. EV-0015 documents cold-control vs dissociated-control making OPPOSITE rTMS predictions. EV-0019 shows trait (baseline) and state (post-induction) markers coexist. EV-0017 raises the post-hoc-ergo-propter-hoc logical gap. EV-0018 shows ALE inconsistency.
